verdict.rationale: Factory supports automation via `droid exec` for CI/CD pipelines, shell scripts, and batch jobs (factory-docs-6, factory-docs-17, factory-docs-41), and Software Factory advertises 'persistent automations' as a tracked capability (factory-docs-44), implying recurring workflows can be wired in via external schedulers/CI cron triggers. However, there is no explicit first-party documentation of a native recurring-job/cron scheduler within Factory itself. Missing for 10: a documented built-in scheduling mechanism (e.g., cron syntax, recurring trigger UI) and independent confirmation that scheduled/recurring jobs actually run reliably.
